Hi Thomas,

Thank you for staying with this, and I'm sorry it has dragged on this long since August. That is on us, not on you.

Here is exactly what our side shows today. Your order Shop····, the NerdOctaxe and the NerdQaxe++, left our Chattanooga warehouse on June 18 under tracking ···· and the carrier marked it delivered on June 24 with a signature. You are right that the photo attached to that delivery is a door tag saying they could not deliver, which does not match a signature. I also checked our warehouse records directly: no return has been received against your order, so as of today the parcel has not come back to us.

That means this has to be settled as a carrier claim on the shipment, with either a replacement or your money back, and that decision is made by Georges or Abel rather than by me. I have put it in front of them with everything above and the full history of this thread, so nothing needs to be sent again. They are offline this evening and pick it up tomorrow morning, and the answer comes to you by email here.

I won't promise you an outcome I don't control, but I will say this plainly: you paid $982.98 and you do not have your miners, and that is going to be resolved.

Best regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi Thomas,

You are not an annoyance, and that question about an alternative is a good one. Let me answer it properly.

On FedEx: the shipment went out under our warehouse's carrier account, and their records say the same thing yours do, delivered on June 24 with a signature, against a photo of a door tag that says nobody was there to sign. Nothing has ever come back to our warehouse, so whatever FedEx told you about a return to sender, the parcel is not with us. I am not going to keep sending you back to them for paperwork they will not produce. The shipment was ours to send, so the resolution is ours.

On the alternative, here is what I can tell you from live stock this morning. Both of the units you bought are discontinued. The NerdOctaxe and the NerdQaxe++ are gone from our lineup, with no stock and no date, so an identical re-ship is not possible. What we do hold on the shelf in the US right now is the Hammer Thor P2 at 10 TH/s, $385, and the Hammer BC04 at 6 TH/s, $249, both shipping within two business days. Two Thor P2s, or a Thor P2 and a BC04, would land close to what you paid and would be a step up in hashrate on what was lost.

Replacing a lost shipment with different hardware is not mine to approve on my own, so I have put that proposal in front of Georges and Abel with the figures above and the full history. They are offline until 10am Eastern today and will pick it up then, and the answer comes to you in this thread. If you reply with which combination you would want, or that you would rather have the money back, they can act on it the moment they open it instead of asking you again.

Best regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
